title: Concept: Marital status in a customer payload
description: A marital status field in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Marital status feeds succession and joint-account decisions, and it is exactly the detail a social-engineering call uses to sound informed.
applicability: Deployments that render a marital status field into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Marital status feeds succession and joint-account decisions, and it is exactly the detail a social-engineering call uses to sound informed.
